_note: The 수첩 (notebook) view, drawn inside the backpack panel (placeholder look: a cream page, dark text, Noto Sans KR). Sizes and font sizes are pixels; colours are r, g, b. 'page_margin' is the space between the page edge and its text. 'scroll_step' is how far one press (or repeat) of the scroll keys moves a page that does not fit. 'arrow_previous' / 'arrow_next' are the flip indicators outside the page edge; they show only when a page exists that way. The panel's title and close button change while the notebook is up: 'back_text' when it was opened from the backpack row (Esc goes back to the list), 'close_text' when it was opened by a quick key.
